title_ru: Fallout 3 — F3DAD: аудит вырезанных актёров, существ, encounter-вариантов и достижимости их инвентаря
title_en: Fallout 3 — F3DAD Cut Actor / Creature / Encounter & Inventory Obtainability Audit v1.5

actor_roots_checked: direct active SCTX .Enable of actor reference
generic XLKR controller using GetLinkedRef -> Enable
LVLN/LVLC membership treated conservatively as a possible encounter root
DOBJ/PERK aligned embedded FormID roots for engine-managed actors
inventory_rules: Explicit CNTO inventory is indexed on NPC_/CREA actor bases.
Item rarity is estimated from the prior all-record item-usage graph, not from actor inventory alone.
A rare item is not promoted when another reachable actor, list, world ref, script path or engine-managed root explains obtainability.
Actors used as templates are excluded from strong inventory-novelty claims unless inheritance semantics are separately resolved.
methodology.claim_boundary: STATIC_UNROOTED_ACTOR_BASE means no inspected root was found under this conservative static graph. It is not proof of impossibility under every engine/savegame condition.

calibration_controls.initial_false_signal: No ordinary ACHR placement; all three explicit gear forms are very rare.
calibration_controls.resolution: DefaultObjectManager DOBJ 00000031 contains the actor FormID at DATA offset 28.
calibration_controls.effect: ENGINE_MANAGED_CONTROL; do not classify the Mysterious Stranger outfit/hat/.44 as trapped secret inventory.

calibration_controls.rare_item: CG04StanleyKey / Ключ от служебных помещений Убежища 101
calibration_controls.resolution: Two REFR controllers 0006B23E and 0006B23F use base TrigPlayerEnable; its script obtains GetLinkedRef and enables the linked target.

calibration_controls.actor_role: template/scaffolding actor with downstream template consumers
calibration_controls.effect: The only remaining static-unrooted actor with rare explicit inventory is not evidence of a trapped unique item.

additional_revision_signal.note: Six persistent initially-disabled preplaced Experiment01 actors remain in DLC05ExLab02 while the live controller dynamically PlaceAtMe-spawns Experiment01.

findings.interpretation: The weapons-lab teleporter preserves at least two cut Brahmin experiment variants with dedicated movement packages. The shipped scene also contains a disabled preplaced Experiment01 cohort alongside the live dynamic-spawn implementation, indicating multiple surviving scene-construction approaches.

public_footprint.registry_contribution: Primary actor/package/placement graph and comparison of the surviving variants.

findings.spatial_note: The production captain reference and the captain-chair reference occupy the same bridge cell; the old and production package families target the same chair reference.
findings.interpretation: The shipped actor graph preserves multiple captain implementations around the same bridge-chair role: an unplaced direct-chair-package actor, an unplaced captain template that feeds the production captain, a test sibling, and the final placed Captain. Exact chronological order between all sibling records is not claimed, but the implementation genealogy is directly visible.

dlc_script_semantics: Advances variable01 after cage packages finish.
When DLC03BS2.DLC03DeathclawControl == 1, kills itself if distance from Link exceeds 1000.

notable_differences: Base script removes Enclave faction rank after cage release.
Base script uses a 6000-unit kill distance rather than 1000.
Base script has an additional 5000-6000 warning-sound band.

findings.source_anomaly_note: The retained DLC03 cage-script source also contains an apparently unmatched trailing endif; this is recorded as source-text residue, not as proof of runtime compilation failure.
findings.interpretation: Broken Steel retains a DLC-specific caged-Enclave-deathclaw implementation with materially different range/faction/sound behavior, but the actor base has no shipped encounter root under the inspected graph. This is a strong creature revision ghost rather than a new player-obtainable creature.

production_actor.explicit_inventory: same three explicit inventory entries as TEMP actor
production_actor.package_graph: many quest-stage packages for greeting, following, HQ, strike-team and objective behavior

findings.interpretation: The TEMP actor preserves a simplified Montgomery implementation with the final character's explicit loadout but only a single follow package and no placement/script root. The production actor replaces it with the full quest-driven package/script architecture.

findings.result: After resolving scripted spawns, linked-ref controllers, leveled-list membership, DOBJ/PERK engine roots and obvious template scaffolding, no high-confidence item was found whose only meaningful obtainability path was the inventory of a statically unreachable actor.

only_remaining_rare_unrooted_inventory_c.why_not_secret: Actor is template/scaffolding; item also exists on MQDad and in RepairVaultSuit FLST.

findings.meaning: v1.5 strengthens the registry by refusing to manufacture a secret-item claim when the strict actor/inventory graph does not support one.

known_public_cut_content_controls.role: The strict actor scan rediscovers them, validating the filter but not creating novelty.
